hero: Autologic Industries is an IATF 16949 certified manufacturer in Delhi and an auto parts supplier for Bangladesh. We export clutch systems, brake shoes, engine components and aluminium die castings to importers, wholesalers and assemblers.

Motorcycles and CNG auto rickshaws carry a large share of daily travel in Bangladesh, and their clutches and brakes wear quickly in dense traffic. Our parts are designed for that duty cycle. Browse the range below and open any product for specifications, applications and export details.

network.title: Why Bangladesh Buyers Source From Us
paras: We have manufactured drivetrain parts for more than 25 years and test every component before dispatch. One supplier for clutch, brake and casting needs keeps your ordering simple.
Our team cross-checks part numbers against the models your customers ride, so you stock fewer slow-moving variants and receive parts that fit the first time.

network.title: Shipping Parts to Bangladesh
paras: Orders travel in palletised export packing by sea freight, usually through Chattogram port, with complete documents for your clearing agent.
We can combine motorcycle, auto rickshaw and casting items in one container, and plan repeat dispatches so your warehouse is restocked before busy seasons.

cta.title: Sourcing parts for the Bangladesh market?
cta.text: Share your part list, models or drawings with expected quantities. Our export team will confirm fitment and send a quotation for delivery to Bangladesh.

faq_intro: Quick answers for importers, distributors and assemblers in Bangladesh who are planning their first order with Autologic Industries.
faqs: Do you supply both motorcycle and auto rickshaw parts to Bangladesh?
Yes. Our range covers two wheeler clutch parts, three-wheeler clutch and brake parts, engine components and aluminium die castings.
What is the minimum order for Bangladesh?
Order size depends on the product, the number of variants and the packing you choose. Share your quantities and we will suggest an FCL or LCL plan that fits.
Can you make parts to our own drawings?
Yes. Our die casting and CNC machining lines produce components from customer drawings or samples after feasibility review.
How do I check part quality before a large order?
Request samples of the parts you need. Once you approve fit and finish, volume production follows the same specification and inspection plan.
